description: Validate a JSON document against a supplied JSON Schema and return actionable validation errors. Example arguments: {json: '{"quantity":7}', schema: '{"type":"object","properties":{"quantity":{"type":"integer"}}}'}.

operationId.description: Stable unique request identifier. Reuse it only for an exact retry.

schema.description: JSON Schema defining the accepted structure of the data.

workspaceToken.description: Secret API token for the workspace; keep it private.

name: json_schema_validate
